CIRCUIT INVENTORY & SPECIFICATIONS | | Col\_1 | Circuit Number/ID (e.g., L1, L2, P1, P2)
Acceptance: Alphanumeric circuit ID matching distribution board schedule | Unique circuit identifier | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Col\_2 | Circuit Description (e.g., Ground Floor Lighting, First Floor Power)
Acceptance: Descriptive name identifying circuit location and purpose | Clear description of circuit purpose | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Col\_3 | MCB/Protection Device Rating (A)
Acceptance: MCB rating in Amperes, device type (B/C/D curve), ELCB 30mA if applicable | Protective device specification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Col\_4 | Cable Size (Sq.mm) - Phase
Acceptance: Cable size in sq.mm (1.5, 2.5, 4, 6, 10, 16, 25, etc.), matches MCB rating | Phase conductor cross-section | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Col\_5 | Cable Size (Sq.mm) - Earth
Acceptance: Earth conductor ≥ 2.5 mm² (typical same as phase), or 1 size down per code | Earth conductor size | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Col\_6 | Circuit Length (m) - From DB to Furthest Point
Acceptance: Measured circuit length in meters, used for continuity resistance and voltage drop calculations | Circuit run length | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Col\_7 | Estimated Connected Load (W)
Acceptance: Sum of all loads (lighting + appliances) connected to circuit in Watts | Total circuit load | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Col\_8 | Design Current (A) - Calculated
Acceptance: Calculated current = Load (W) / Voltage (V), should be < MCB rating with safety margin | Design circuit current | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | TESTS. TESTING RECORDS | | Test\_1 | Insulation Resistance Test (MΩ) - Date and Result
Acceptance: Test date recorded, result ≥ 1.0 MΩ at 500V DC, test certificate reference | Pre-commissioning insulation test | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Test\_2 | Continuity Test (Ω) - Phase, Neutral, Earth - Date and Result
Acceptance: Test date, continuity ≤ 0.1 Ω/10m for phase/neutral, ≤ 0.05 Ω/10m for earth, test report reference | Conductor continuity verification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Test\_3 | Earth Loop Impedance (Ω) - Date and Result
Acceptance: Test date, Zs ≤ 1.5 Ω for 16A circuits, result recorded, test report reference | Loop impedance measurement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Test\_4 | Functional Test / Load Test - Date and Result
Acceptance: Test date, circuit operates as designed, MCB functions correctly, all outlets/switches working | Circuit operation verification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | APPROVAL. INSTALLATION APPROVAL & COMMISSIONING | | Appr\_1 | Installation Completed Date
Acceptance: Date recorded when all circuit wiring, devices, and testing completed | Date of installation completion | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Appr\_2 | QC Inspection Completed - Date, Inspector Name, Sign
Acceptance: Inspection date, QC engineer name and signature, overall compliance confirmed | QC verification sign-off | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Appr\_3 | Commissioning & Energization - Date, Authority Approval
Acceptance: Energization date recorded, authorized signature obtained, all tests passed | Circuit energization approval | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | Appr\_4 | Final Handover to Client - Date, Client Signature
Acceptance: Handover date, client sign-off, operation and maintenance manual provided | Installation handover | OK
NC
